description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeMembershipAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various CRUD operations, validation rules, and internal service interactions for the EmployeeMembership API within the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeMembershipAPI covering get, create, update, delete, and list operations, with validation and authorization checks.

methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing from a YAML file into the database.

methods.name: testDelete

methods.name: testUpdate
